name: I Am Weasel
description: The adventures of the noble, generous, intelligent and good-at-everything I.M. Weasel, who must compete once again with his arch-enemy, the bumbling, brainless and utterly talentless I.R. Baboon.

videos.title: This Bridge, Not Weasel Bridge
videos.overview: I.R. is in charge on making a bridge from the U.S. to France, but when Weasel takes over, I.R. vows for revenge.

videos.title: I.R. on Sun
videos.overview: I.R. is jealous of I.M. Weasel (I.M. being the first on Mars, Jupiter and Uranus). But then NASA tells I.R. that he can become the first on the sun, and I.R. readily accepts the job. This creates quite the challenge for I.M...

videos.title: Deep Sea Tour
videos.overview: I.R. has his own ""Deep Sea Tour"" company, which takes people to the bottom of the sea.

videos.title: I.R. Gentlemans
videos.overview: It's discovered that I.R. is the king of the kingdom of Yurp, so Weasel must turn him into a gentleman.

videos.title: I Are Big Star
videos.overview: I.R. will do anything to get Weasel's role on his last movie.

videos.title: Power of Odor
videos.overview: I.R. starts his own pig farm, covering the whole town with an awful stench.

videos.title: Ping Pong at Sea
videos.overview: Weasel is going to face a human in a ping-pong duel. A jealous I.R. tells the human  that he's won a trip, so I.R. can duel Weasel himself. But as I.R realizes that he doesn't stand a chance, he resorts to cheating.

videos.title: Disease Fiesta
videos.overview: While Weasel is trying to cure an athlete's face patient, I.R. Baboon creates a cure which goes wrong and spreads it over the town.

videos.title: I.R. Plant Life
videos.overview: I.R. falls in love with a flower he has grown.

videos.title: I Am Ambassador
videos.overview: Two dudes take a group of beavers hostage and Weasel must save them.

videos.title: Happy Baboon Holidays
videos.overview: It's Christmas, and I.R.'s family pays a visit. But when they go to Weasel's house instead, I.R. vows to ruin Christmas.

videos.title: Law of Gravity
videos.overview: I.R. destroys the Law of Gravity (literally), which causes all lawyers to float (since they are the only ones that understand law).

videos.title: I, Architect
videos.overview: An accident causes Weasel and I.R. to drop their brains.These get swapped while being unconscious.

videos.title: I.R. Mommy
videos.overview: I.R. finds an abandoned baby and adopts him as his son.

videos.title: I Am Deity
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. create their forms of life.

videos.title: I Am Crybaby
videos.overview: Weasel must relocate the people who suffer from the cronic crybaby syndrome, not knowing that they are the main source of water on the planet.

videos.title: I.R.'s Phantom Foot
videos.overview: I.R. hurts himself while walking up to Weasel's house! Weasel discovers that I.R. has broken his phantom foot! When I.R. goes to see Dr Clearbottom on phantom limbs, this doc's services are at a very high price! Weasel later reveals that it was Clearbottom who dug the hole which injured I.R.'s phantom foot so he can take all his money!

videos.title: Queen of DeNile
videos.overview: In ancient Egipt, Weasel and I.R. must save the queen from a huge group of snakes.

videos.title: I Are Music Man
videos.overview: I.R. competes against Weasel in a music concert.

videos.title: I Am My Lifetime
videos.overview: Now retired and living in asylums, Weasel and I.R. recall the days when they were young.

videos.title: I.R. Pixie Fairie
videos.overview: The Red Guy tells us a story about a small group of Baboon Fairies and how they all work together as presidents, with I.R. Baboon as their slave.

videos.title: I.R. Ice Fisher
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. try some ice fishing in the artic.

videos.title: I.R. Role Model
videos.overview: I Am Weasel saves a woman from a fire, but everyone thinks I.R. did it and Weasel actually started the fire.

videos.title: I.R. in Wrong Cartoon
videos.overview: Cow selfishly wants Weasel for herself so she fishes him out of the tv with a pie! But I.R. becomes very lonely without Weasel.

videos.title: My Friend, the Smart Banana
videos.overview: While working on a supermarket, Weasel meets a smart banana with the ability of speaking.

videos.title: I.R. Wild Baboon
videos.overview: Weasel investigates the strange habits of I.R., who keeps changing his habitat due to unknown reasons.

videos.title: Time Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel creates a time machine that I.R. uses to go back in time, but Weasel discovers that I.R. is destined to solve all kind of problems at certain periods.

videos.title: The Hole
videos.overview: Weasel comes to investigate the world's largest hole, same hole I.R. tries to fill with cement.

videos.title: I Stand Corrected
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are sent to a correctional institute were everyone is forced to wear stupid corrective devices.

videos.title: I Am Bush Pilot
videos.overview: Weasel is the captain of his own comercial plane, and must take a bunch of people up a river with I.R. as his co-pilot.

videos.title: Dessert Island
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. end up stranded on an island made entirely of confectionaries.

videos.title: Unsinkable I.R.
videos.overview: I.R. is captain of his own ship, until it bumps an iceberg and it starts sinking.

videos.title: I Am Vampire
videos.overview: Weasel and Baboon are a pair of friendly vampires who drink only canned blood and are just looking for a fun little night on the town in Pantsylvania. But someone should try telling that to the vampire hunter Dr. von Smellstein, who's out to get our heroes!

videos.title: Honey I Are Home
videos.overview: I.R. is jealous of his neighbor Weasel because he has a better wife, kids job and house than him.

videos.title: Driver's Sped
videos.overview: The trees decide to rebel against humans after I.R. chops one.

videos.title: A Tree Story
videos.overview: The trees decide to rebel against humans after I.R. chops one.

videos.title: I.R. Do
videos.overview: I.R. is getting married with a hyena, but it happens that she ran away with a German, hairless chihuahua.

videos.title: I Are Good Dog!
videos.overview: A kid adopts Weasel and I.R. as his pet dogs.

videos.title: He Said, He Said.
videos.overview: Weasel tells his story to psiquiatrist Sigmund Fraud about his mishaps with I.R., at the same time I.R. is telling his own mishaps with Weasel in the room next door.

videos.title: Enemy Camp
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. remember the days in which they were good friends, until they were send to Enemy Camp.

videos.title: I Am Clichéd
videos.overview: The director of Weasel and I.R.'s cartoons does nothing but stealing old clichés from classic cartoons.

videos.title: I Are Gladiator
videos.overview: Back in Roman times, Weasel and I.R. battle each other as gladiators.

videos.title: Revolutionary Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. tell their grandsons how they influenced U.S. history.

videos.title: I Are Ghost
videos.overview: Weasel and Baboon are ghosts, assigned to haunt the house of a washed-up movie starlet (played by the Red Guy). But Baboon keeps goofing up, and even Weasel is finding the starlet a hard scare.

videos.title: The Magnificient Motorbikini
videos.overview: Weasel & Baboon try out Weasel's latest invention: The Magnifi-  cient Motorbikini! But the Motorbikini doesn't have any brake(why I.R. came too late) and that results trouble, trouble... and trouble.

videos.title: I Am Hairstylist
videos.overview: Weasel is a talented hairstylist, while Baboon has an awful job doing toes. And thing's don't look really good when Red Guy the Hair-Police tries to book'em up!

videos.title: I Am Whale Captain
videos.overview: Weasel the Whale Captain is looking for the giant squid.

videos.title: Dream Weasel
videos.overview: I am Weasel has created a machine giving dreams to the dreamless.

videos.title: The Baboon's Paw
videos.overview: I.R. discovers that he has magical paws granting all awful wishes.

videos.title: The Sackless Games
videos.overview: Weasel & Baboon join Red Guys version of Olympians: The Sackless Games!

videos.title: Who Rubbed Out Cow and Chicken?
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. investigate the crime of who is erasing the characters from Cow & Chicken.

videos.title: I Are Good Salesmans
videos.overview: Baboon's selling wild fire door-to-door, and Weasel must stop him!

videos.title: I Are Terraformer
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. travel to the Moon to create a new form of living, through oxygen, cities and plants.

videos.title: I Am Viking
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are Vikings, who are ready, willing and able to pillage and plunder anything in sight. However, is it not too late to join The Red Guy in being a Viking cheerleader?

videos.title: The Drinking Fountain of Youth
videos.overview: In a Christopher Columbus-like story, Weasel and I.R. set sail to find the Drinking Fountain of Youth.

videos.title: Leave it to Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are called in as replacement kids after a couple's real children go away to camp.

videos.title: The Fairy Godfather
videos.overview: Based on Cinderella, Cinder-Weasel tries to make it to the evening ball, despite the interference of his evil stepbrother, I.R. Baboon. Can our Weasel get help from his Fairy Godfather (The Red Guy)?

videos.title: I Are Robin Hood
videos.overview: I.R. Baboon takes the role of Robin Hood, with Weasel being his ally, Little John.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Weasel
videos.overview: Doctors Weasel and I.R. shrink themselves in order to perform an operation, which is to repair a crack in The Red Guy's butt cheek.

videos.title: Baboon Man & Weasel Boy
videos.overview: Based on Batman, I.R. Baboon is the hero known as Baboon Man, whereas Weasel is his sidekick, Weasel Boy.

videos.title: I.M.N. Love
videos.overview: Whilst at the gym, Weasel and I.R. fall in love with Cow and Chicken's Teacher.

videos.title: I.R.'s First Bike
videos.overview: I.R. gets a bike for Christmas. Learning of his inexperience, Weasel tries to help him.

videos.title: The Sorcerer's a Dentist
videos.overview: Back in the medieval times, Weasel is a dentist with wizardry powers with Baboon as his envious nurse.

videos.title: The Wrong Bros.
videos.overview: Based on the true story of The Wright Brothers, The Red Guy narrates a documentary about The Right Bros. and the Wrong Bros. (Weasel and I.R.), competing to see who could invent the first plane.

videos.title: I Am Cave Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel and Baboon are cave-men living back in the prehistoric times, while Weasel tries to invent new products to create the future.

videos.title: My Blue Hiney
videos.overview: A narrator tells the story about the travelling country-singing duo of Weasel and Baboon.

videos.title: Mission: Stupid
videos.overview: Weasel and Baboon are troops enlisted in the U.S Ground Force and must rescue a lone kitty stuck in a tree.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are sent back to repeat the 4th Grade, in which they would go to the same school as Cow and Chicken.

videos.title: I Are a Artiste
videos.overview: The Red Guy narrates the story of when Weasel and Baboon moved to Paris in 1909 to become famous artists.

videos.title: Fred: Last of the Idiots
videos.overview: Weasel and Baboon are on an expedition to capture a wild, dim-witted savage named Fred. When they manage to capture him, Weasel, however, cannot understand his unusual language.

videos.title: I Are Bellhop
videos.overview: Weasel works at a hotel as the manager, whereas I.R. is his incompetent bellhop. However, Weasel needs to rely on I.R's help when an acclaimed cannibal actor (The Red Guy) wants to eat him for dinner.

videos.title: Take I.R. Out to the Ballgame
videos.overview: IR and Weasel go to a baseball game and Weasel wants to watch all of it, but IR will make sure that that doesn't happen.

videos.title: I Bee Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are worker bees, and our red-butt baboon wants to do a honey dance like all the other bees, but it soon results in further problems.

videos.title: I Am Franken-Weasel
videos.overview: Based on the story of Frankenstein, Weasel is a mad scientist, whereas I.R. is his assistant.

videos.title: A Troo Storee
videos.overview: Weasel's theory on monkeys typing Shakespeare goes wrong when almost every monkey involved walks out on him. However, he sees hope in the form of I.R. Baboon, who writes a book entitled "A Troo Storee," despite the fact that it lowers peoples' I.Q. level.

videos.title: Rodeo Weasel
videos.overview: Weasel is famous cowboy working in a rodeo in which Baboon is a clown. Cow and Chicken's teacher and her husband appear in this episode.

videos.title: The Legend of Big Butt
videos.overview: Weasel and I.R. are in search of a legend known as Big Butt, which later happens to be The Red Guy.

videos.title: I Am Dragon Slayer
videos.overview: It's the Middle Ages, and Weasel and I.R. are looking for a dragon to slay.

videos.title: I Are Legend
videos.overview: Weasel, I.R. and The Red Guy are believed to be the last beings on Earth, until they discover that everybodys been watching their show... where it turns out that Baboon is really the star!
